fatal_blockers: The proposed simple-path mutation cannot asymptotically amplify the critical weight-q+2 NO witnesses. Such an odd cover has total incidence excess 6, so at most nine selected triples participate in conflicts and its induced incompatibility graph has at most 21 edges; consequently it activates only O(1) simple paths, independent of q.

The current nonbacktracking mechanism has no uniform soundness argument: amplification can come from repeatedly indexing the same constant collision structure, while affine sums can cancel every shell coordinate. A collision alone therefore does not imply polynomially many surviving mixed-word features.

The implemented code generator is obtained by enumerating every affine-fiber point and spanning all nonlinear lifts. The packet gives no polynomial-time method to construct this span for the logarithmic walk length needed asymptotically; bounded output-coordinate count alone does not establish an efficient reduction.

All positive measurements are for fixed q=3,m=8 codes of dimension at most four. The ratio 11 and exponent 0.3352636 are finite suite statistics and cannot support any asymptotic NCP or CVP hardness claim.

The suggested bounded-degree assumption is not supplied by an explicit gap-preserving source reduction, and even bounded degree would only make walk enumeration polynomial; it would not prevent mixed-word cancellation or guarantee growth on every near-minimum NO cover.
evidence: The supplied verifier exits zero and exactly reports primary length 4 with worst YES 3, best tested NO 33, nominal length at most 1277, and 103136 enumerated span words over ten YES and 200 deterministic NO dictionaries.

The source exhaustively computes each incidence fiber using all 2^m selections, lifts every fiber point, row-reduces their span, and enumerates all combinations of the resulting basis. This verifies the bounded instances but also exposes the missing efficient asymptotic construction.

The all-eight and twisted-holonomy dictionaries are YES instances with mixed minima 2 and 3; their illegal words of costs 6 and 9 merely demonstrate complete shell cancellation. They are not adversarial NO instances establishing or refuting a NO lower bound.

STATUS, NOTES, IDEAS, and proof_cvp consistently label the result finite and explicitly disclaim polynomial output, asymptotic soundness, NCP hardness, and CVP hardness. No promotion beyond that finite claim is justified.
next_experiment: None for the proposed simple-path mutation; it is combinatorially incapable of amplifying q+2 odd covers. Reopen only with an explicit polynomial-time generator and a new feature family proved to charge every near-minimum NO mixed word by q^Omega(1) despite affine cancellation.
